claims: Claude Code can extract video content, cut it together, add text overlays, voiceovers, B-roll and subtitles
It dissected ~10 hour-long guest sessions, created themed mashups (e.g. '5 operators on what AI actually changes', 'Why ugly ads beat polished ones'), with a dynamic name/role tag under each speaker
All mashups are already live in his Meta ad account; no editor, no CapCut; done 'while I was at lunch'
how_to_steps: Point Claude Code at long-form recordings; have it transcribe them
Give it themes; it pulls the most relevant quotes/clips per theme
Have it build 9:16 Remotion compositions: branded header, speaker card with name/role tag, karaoke captions, progress bar, CTA, branded end card
With Meta Ads connected, have Claude upload them as ads

relevance.why: A real, working content-repurposing pipeline (long-form -> ad variants -> ad account) that a solo founder could run for his own products; depends on having long-form footage and Meta ads spend.

implement_score.why: Feasible with Remotion + Whisper transcription + a Meta Marketing API MCP; a weekend to build a repeatable skill. Only worth it if Haji is running video ads or repurposing recordings.

gap.what: Liked set had Remotion as a repo pitch, Claude Motion, and a reaction to Claude Code running Meta ads; this is the first end-to-end technique: transcript-driven clip selection, Remotion mashup templates with dynamic speaker tags, and direct upload to Meta Ads.
